skill.name: writing-beats
skill.description: Build articles from raw notes through an interactive beat-by-beat workflow. The user chooses each direction before the next section is written.
skill.summary: Build narrative articles one beat at a time from raw notes.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: The static finding is a false positive. The flagged line asks for a user-provided article save path and does not request system reconnaissance or sensitive file discovery.

static_findings.snippet: If the user did not say where to save the article, ask once and remember the path.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 10 asks where to save the article when the user has not provided a path. It does not instruct the model to inspect the system, enumerate files, or collect sensitive environment details.

content.user_title: Build Article Beats From Raw Notes
content.value_statement: Raw notes can be hard to turn into a readable article. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through one chosen narrative beat at a time.
actual_capabilities: Creates multiple starting beats from supplied raw material.
Writes only the beat selected by the user.
Offers next-beat options after each written section.
Re-reads the article file before each new write.
Preserves user edits when continuing the article.
limitations: Requires raw material from the user before drafting.
Does not write a full article in one pass.
Needs a user-approved file path for saved output.
May leave unused source notes when the article is complete.

use_cases.title: Turn Research Notes Into Essays
use_cases.description: Convert scattered notes into a paced article through selected narrative moves.

use_cases.title: Develop Founder or Product Stories
use_cases.description: Shape raw product memories into a story that unfolds through clear beats.

use_cases.title: Draft Personal Blog Posts
use_cases.description: Explore different openings and continue only when the next direction feels right.

prompt_templates.title: Start From Notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin a new article from a raw markdown file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use writing-beats with my raw notes in notes.md. Ask where to save the article, then suggest three starting beats.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Starting Beat
prompt_templates.scenario: Select one opening direction and draft only that beat.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the second starting beat. Write only that beat to the article file, then stop and show possible next beats.

prompt_templates.title: Revise the Current Beat
prompt_templates.scenario: Change a written section without continuing the article.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite the current beat with a sharper opening. Keep the same direction and do not write the next beat yet.

prompt_templates.title: Continue After Edits
prompt_templates.scenario: Resume after the user manually changed earlier text.
prompt_templates.prompt: Re-read the article file, account for my edits, then suggest three next beats that fit the current draft.

output_examples.input: Raw notes about a difficult launch, a quiet customer insight, and a late product change.
output_examples.output: Three possible starting beats: the launch day problem, the customer insight, or the product change that reframed the story.

output_examples.input: The user chooses the customer insight as the opening.
output_examples.output: A short opening beat focused on the customer moment, followed by next-beat options for tension, context, or consequence.

output_examples.input: The user asks to go back and try a different third beat.
output_examples.output: The third beat is replaced in place, while the rest of the article is preserved.

best_practices: Provide rich raw notes with dates, examples, quotes, and unresolved questions.
Choose each beat deliberately before asking the skill to write it.
Review the article file between beats when the tone or direction matters.
anti_patterns: Asking for a complete article before choosing a starting beat.
Using the skill without source material to draw from.
Requesting many future beats before the current beat is written.

faq.question: Does this skill write the whole article at once?
faq.answer: No. It writes one selected beat at a time and waits for the next user choice.

faq.question: Can I edit the article between beats?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill re-reads the article file before continuing and should preserve user edits.

faq.question: What kind of raw material works best?
faq.answer: Notes, fragments, quotes, memories, examples, and rough arguments all work well.

faq.question: Can I change an earlier beat?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask the skill to rewrite or replace a specific beat in place.

faq.question: Does every note need to appear in the article?
faq.answer: No. The skill treats notes as source material and may leave unused fragments behind.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
